title: Thin bin/work-items adapter over bd
description: Policy expects bin/work-items for ready/next/close. Provide thin wrapper so agents do not call raw bd for selection verbs.
acceptance_criteria: bin/work-items ready|next|close|doctor work; documents mapping to bd

title: Add STATUS.md, project.yaml, and bin/orient
description: Make the repo agent-operable: compact STATUS pointer, project identity yaml, lightweight bin/orient printing git status + STATUS + bd ready.
acceptance_criteria: bin/orient runs; STATUS.md points to authorities; project.yaml has id/remote; no harness dependency
close_reason: STATUS.md, project.yaml, bin/orient shipped and orient smoke-tested

title: Export/sync Beads issues.jsonl for readable ledger
description: Ensure passive export exists if project expects issues.jsonl in git for viewers.
acceptance_criteria: bd export produces .beads/issues.jsonl or documented why not

title: MCP Streamable HTTP / SSE transport in addition to stdio
description: Expose registry tools over HTTP MCP transport for remote clients; keep stdio as default.
acceptance_criteria: apps/mcp can start stdio or http mode; smoke test covers tool list over both
close_reason: Streamable HTTP + stdio; apps/mcp --http; client listTools smoke; docs

title: Add create-cli-mcp-app scaffolder for new products
description: Scaffold a new ops package + apps wiring from a name/slug so this monorepo can spawn products without copy-paste.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm create or scripts/scaffold generates package with one sample op and green tests
close_reason: pnpm scaffold + @cli-mcp/scaffold; notes product generated with green tests; docs updated

title: CLI+MCP+API boilerplate — post-v1 backlog
description: Post-merge backlog after v1 Operation Registry boilerplate landed on main (PR #1). Track deferred features and agent-ops hardening.

title: Persist sample tasks store (file or sqlite) for multi-process CLI+API
description: In-memory store means CLI and API cannot share data across processes. Add optional file/sqlite backend for demos.
acceptance_criteria: API create visible to subsequent CLI list when configured

title: Optional OpenAPI import path into Operation Registry
description: Hybrid path: import OpenAPI operations as registry stubs (handlers still hand-written).
acceptance_criteria: CLI or package converts openapi paths into OperationDef skeletons with http surfaces
